title: Vertical Insight Tailorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners adapt one legacy-systems Challenger insight for Healthcare, Financial Services and Technology by choosing a framing and messaging focus, then compare the rewritten insights.

learningObjectives: Adapt a Challenger insight for different industry verticals by selecting the appropriate framing and messaging focus.
prerequisites: Industry Vertical Segmentation sections of Chapter 3

keyQuestions: Adapt a Challenger insight for different industry verticals by selecting the appropriate framing and messaging focus.
commonMisconceptions: The same insight works across all industries.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct framing and focus for all three verticals.
A learner-written Manufacturing adaptation that uses operational-efficiency language and a concrete metric.
